name: Investigation Case
definition: Set of activities performed to handle an exception to a normal transaction flow..

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Creation date and time of the case.

EIR.name: EIR
EIR.definition: Unique identifier to provide the end-to-end reference of an investigation.

RequestorInvestigationIdentification.name: Requestor Investigation Identification
RequestorInvestigationIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the requestor, to unambiguously identify the investigation for the requestor.

ResponderInvestigationIdentification.name: Responder Investigation Identification
ResponderInvestigationIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the responder, to unambiguously identify the investigation for the responder.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Specifies the status of the case together with the reason and the date and time.

InvestigationPartyRole.name: Investigation Party Role
InvestigationPartyRole.definition: Role played by a party in the context of an investigation process.

DuplicateCaseResolution.name: Duplicate Case Resolution
DuplicateCaseResolution.definition: Solution which consists in closing the case as it is a duplicate of an original one.

InvestigationResolution.name: Investigation Resolution
InvestigationResolution.definition: Specifies the actions taken as a result of an investigation.

OriginalInvestigationCase.name: Original Investigation Case
OriginalInvestigationCase.definition: Original case to which another one is linked.

LinkedCase.name: Linked Case
LinkedCase.definition: Step in the resolution process of an investigation case. The assigned case is linked to the investigation case in the previous step.

Reassignment.name: Reassignment
Reassignment.definition: Action which is taken to forward the case to another party.
